thingsToDo: A number input sets the step (default 1).
Increment / decrement change the count by the current step.
Reset sets the count back to 0 and the step back to 1.

instructions.intro: Add these `data-testid` attributes to the matching elements in your solution so the **Submit** checks can verify it:

testIds.description: the number input for the step

tests.name: Increment adds the default step of 1
